label: Self-giving must instantiate efficient self-causation in respect esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst cross-sense causal bridge: if in history v the same bearer c exercises strict time-indexed GivesAt v c c t toward its OWN being at t, this qualifies as efficient self-causation of c in the selected esse respect under the separately supplied EfficientlyCausesIn relation. This bridge connects two different causal senses only on the self-edge. It does not identify the frame's CausesIn perfection-causation relation with efficient causes, require a physical temporal interval, or claim any real self-giving is possible.
